rows.quote: The recent Reporting Recommendations Intended for Pharmaceutical Risk Minimization Evaluation Studies: Standards for Reporting of Implementation Studies Extension (RIMES-SE)13, tailored to study designs frequently used for RMM evaluation (42), should be used to standardise reporting of the results of such studies. Reporting items have been derived from the RIMES-SE standard for reporting results of RMM effectiveness studies (see Table XVI.App.II.1., RIMES-SE items are marked by #), to facilitate the completion of the final report in the format described in GVP Module VIII.
